remarks: Modern living meets historic charm in this NYC Style Loft Rental unit with 20-foot ceilings, expansive 2 story windows, rustic wood beams and exposed brick. This updated unit features gleaming hardwood flooring throughout, an open-concept kitchen with white marble counters & stainless-steel appliances (2025 dishwasher & microwave). The half-bath is conveniently located on the main level, while the private bedroom suite upstairs offers a newly renovated bathroom (2025) and walk in closet. Residents enjoy access to reserved parking, a fitness center, sauna, a community room, game lounge, conference room, and an inviting outdoor landscaped courtyard. A laundry room is conveniently located on each floor. Minutes from downtown South Norwalk, the Sono Mall, trending restaurants, Norwalk beaches, and easy access to the train station, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway.
